arguments.explanation: Flags swipe transactions over $1,000, a stricter version of the earlier $500 swipe rule.
assumptions: 'Over $1,000' is read as amount_usd_cents > 100000 (strictly greater than $1,000.00), keeping the swipe-only condition from the earlier rule.
Negative amounts are not treated specially; they fail the > 100000 test and so are not flagged.
